This week, my colleagues and I had the pleasure of attending what might just be the best conference in the world: the CSMA conference in Giens! As always, it was an incredible experience.

I am also happy to share that I have been elected to the CSMA Junior Board (representing researchers under 40). I’m looking forward to contributing to the community, stay tuned for updates on what we have planned next!
